name: 614. A Gemini batch line sent as it is has its url checked: a url the batch cannot run is a 400 before the batch is sent (gemini batch native url)
description: TXE-7058: a Gemini API batch line whose body is in Gemini shape (contents, no messages or prompt) is sent as it is. Its url was never checked, so a native line with /v1/embeddings or /v1/images/generations was sent in the batch and created. The gateway now refuses it with 400, error.param requests[i].url, error_type caller_unsupported_parameter, before the batch is sent. Folder 613 covers the Vertex route. Both rows run on the provider error fixture (gemini base_url -> the fixture) with providerErrorFixture=1 and are skipped otherwise. The fixture serves no Gemini batch create, so before this change each row got the fixture's error for that call, not this 400.
